title: Corporate Agency Manager - Key Alliances
description:

Bancassurance is the largest sales channel of HDFC Life which includes selling life insurance through Bancassurance partners like HDFC Bank.


With its vision to be the highest performing Bancassurance channel in the industry, the team has its presence in 400\+ locations in the country.


### **Essential Qualification**


Age: 21 \- 38 years


Education: Graduation in any stream


Minimum Sales Experience: 6 months to 4 years

title: Technical Engineer Omnichannel
description:
**About AkzoNobel**


Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance the fabric of everyday life. Because we believe every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long\-established paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

  

For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com

  

© 2026 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved.


**Job Purpose**
---------------



We are looking for a **Senior Conversational AI / Chatbot Developer** to support the development and expansion of an enterprise **Omnichannel customer service platform** across channels such as WhatsApp, web chat, email and other digital touchpoints.


The role is primarily hands\-on and will focus on designing and developing chatbot journeys, automation workflows, backend integrations and self\-service capabilities that reduce dependency on human support while providing a seamless customer experience.


The candidate will work closely with technical leads, business teams, customer service stakeholders and integration teams to take requirements from design through development, testing and production.

**Key Activities**
------------------


* Design and develop **Conversational AI and chatbot journeys** for customer service use cases.
* Build automated flows for common customer requests, case deflection and self\-service scenarios.
* Develop and configure **intent classification, conversational flows, responses and business rules**.
* Implement smooth **handover\-to\-agent** journeys with the required customer and conversation context.
* Integrate chatbot solutions with enterprise systems through **REST APIs and backend services**.
* Support integrations with CRM, SAP, case management and other enterprise applications.
* Build omnichannel experiences across **WhatsApp, web chat, email and other digital channels**.
* Translate functional requirements into technically feasible chatbot and automation solutions.
* Support development from **requirement understanding and solution design through testing, deployment and production support**.
* Troubleshoot chatbot, API, integration and platform\-related issues.
* Implement appropriate error handling, fallback scenarios and exception management.
* Support testing, UAT, release activities and post\-production stabilization.
* Work with technical leads to establish reusable chatbot components, integration patterns and development standards.
* Identify opportunities to improve automation, customer experience and case\-deflection capabilities.


Maintain technical documentation for chatbot flows, integrations and configurations.

**Experience**
--------------


* Around **4–5 years of experience** in software development, chatbot development, Conversational AI or automation.
* Hands\-on experience developing **chatbots or customer\-service automation solutions**.
* Strong understanding of conversational flows, intents, entities, context management and fallback handling.
* Experience with **REST APIs, JSON and backend integrations**.
* Good programming or scripting experience, preferably with **Python, JavaScript or similar technologies**.
* Experience integrating applications with CRM, ERP or other enterprise systems.
* Understanding of authentication, API security and enterprise integration concepts.
* Experience with development, testing, debugging and production support.
* Ability to understand business requirements and independently deliver assigned technical solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication skills and ability to collaborate with technical and business stakeholders.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

* Experience with **Sprinklr Conversational AI / Contact Center platforms**.
* Experience with WhatsApp Business or similar messaging\-channel integrations.
* Customer service, contact center or case\-management platform experience.
* Experience integrating with **SAP, CRM or enterprise case\-management systems**.
* Experience with Agentic AI, Generative AI or LLM\-based conversational solutions.
* Knowledge\-base integration and automated answer\-generation experience.
* Experience with multilingual or multi\-country chatbot implementations.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms and API management.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* Hands\-on development
* Conversational and customer\-experience thinking
* End\-to\-end ownership of assigned use cases
* Strong integration and API skills
* Problem solving and troubleshooting
* Quality and testing mindset
* Collaboration and stakeholder communication
* Reusable and scalable solution thinking
* Continuous improvement

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


The successful candidate will independently deliver high\-quality **Conversational AI and chatbot solutions**, build reliable integrations with enterprise systems, improve customer self\-service and automation, and contribute to scaling the Omnichannel platform across multiple channels and markets.

title: Sr. Principal Solution Consultant
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

**The Role**
------------


AspenTech is an AI\-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market\-leading company with double\-digit growth and a blue\-chip customer base. We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.  

  

As a Sr. Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value\-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.  

In this customer\-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.**Your Impact**
---------------

* Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
* Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
* Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.
* Developing the messaging and materials necessary to position AspenTech solutions in the industry – making adaptations for regional or market differences.
* Partnering closely with Sales Account Managers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design to executive presentations and deal execution.
* Engaging the senior executive level of customer organisations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their digitalisation journey.
* Developing industry\-specific solutions, aligning technology with measurable business value.
* Providing market input to the Product Management teams to improve solution adoption.
* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech’s reach, pipeline and awareness.
* Coaching and enabling Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on industry\-specific messaging, customer engagement strategies and solution positioning.
* Representing AspenTech at industry conferences, customer forums, webinars and trade events across the region.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* 14 \+ years of experience in industrial software, services, solution consulting, presales, technical sales or related customer\-facing technical roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline (preferred).
* Proficiency in Industrial Data Platforms (Inmation), Historians (IP.21\), and Advanced Process Control (APC) \& Real Time Optimization (RTO) (DMC3, GDOT, Aspen Plus), or equivalent competitor technologies.
* Demonstrated successes in business development.
* Strong ability to bridge technology and business, articulating high\-level technical solutions and their differentiated value.
* Strong drive to convert opportunities into recognised value for customers, with exceptional problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in English.
* Must be authorized to work in India without restriction/sponsorship.

**Nice\-to\-Have**

* Services or solution consulting exposure to industries such as Metals \& Mining, LNG, Specialty Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Polymers, Consumer Packaged Goods, Food \& Beverage, Pulp \& Paper, Power Generation, and Water \& Wastewater.
* Breadth across several AspenTech solution areas / well\-rounded across multiple disciplines.
* Knowledge of AI/ML solutions and their application in industry.
* Strong understanding of digital transformation initiatives within asset\-intensive industries.
* Working knowledge of Supply Chain/Production Planning \& Scheduling \- Aspen Plant Scheduler, Aspen Unified Planning, or equivalent competitor technologies.


Regional travel up to 35%.


\#LI\-RK1

title: Delivery Solutions Architect
description:
CSQ427R264


At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems by utilising the the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.
  

  

As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you will play an important role during this journey. You will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks platform in your customers. You will also help ensure customer success by increasing focus and technical accountability to our most complex customers who need guidance to accelerate usage on Databricks workloads that they have already selected, helping them maximise the value they get of our platform and the return on investment.
  

  

This is a hybrid technical and commercial role. It is commercial in the sense that you will drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases through leading your customers' stakeholders, building executive relationships, orchestration of other focused/ specialised teams within Databricks, and creating and driving plans and strategies for Databricks colleagues to build upon. This is in parallel to being technical, with expectations being that you become the post\-sale technical lead across all Databricks products. This requires you to use your skills and technical credibility to engage and communicate at all levels with an organisation. You will report directly to a DSA Manager within the Field Engineering organization.
  

  

**The impact you will have:**
* Engage with Solutions Architects to understand the full use case demand plan for prioritised customers
* Lead the post\-technical win technical account strategy and execution plan for the majority of Databricks use cases within our most strategic accounts
* Be the accountable technical leader assigned to specific use cases and customer(s) across multiple selling teams and internal stakeholders, creating certainty from uncertainty and driving onboarding, enablement, success, go\-live and healthy consumption of the workloads where the customer has made the decision to consume Databricks
* Be the first contact for any technical issues or questions related to production/go live status of agreed upon use cases within an account, oftentimes services multiple use cases within the largest and most complex organizations
* Leverage both Shared Services, User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services and Support resources, along with escalating to expert level technical experts to build the right tasks that are beyond your scope of activities or expertise
* Create, own and execute a point\-of\-view as to how key use cases can be accelerated into production, coordinating with Professional Services (PS) resources on the delivery of PS Engagement proposals
* Navigate Databricks Product and Engineering teams for new product Innovations, private previews and upgrade needs
* Develop an execution plan that covers all activities of all customer\-facing technical roles and teams to cover the below work streams:
	+ Main use cases moving from ‘win’ to production
	+ Enablement / user growth plan
	+ Product adoption (strategy and activities to increase adoption of Databricks’ Lakehouse vision)
	+ Organic needs for current investment (e.g. cloud cost control, tuning \& optimization)
	+ Executive and operational governance
* Provide internal and external updates \- KPI reporting on the status of usage and customer health, covering investment status, important risks, product adoption and use case progression \- to your Technical GM

**What we look for:**
* 10\+ years of experience where you have been accountable for technical project / program delivery within the domain of Data and AI and where you can contribute to technical debate and design choices with customers
* Programming experience in Python, SQL or Scala
* Experience in a customer\-facing pre\-sales, technical architecture, customer success, or consulting role
* Understanding of solution architecture related distributed data systems
* Understanding of how to attribute business value and outcomes to specific project deliverables
* Technical program, or project management including account, stakeholder and resource management accountability
* Experience resolving complex and important escalation with senior customer executives
* Experience conducting open\-ended discovery workshops, creating strategic roadmaps, conducting business analysis and managing delivery of complex programmes/projects
* Track record of overachievement against quota, Goals or similar objective targets
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience through work experience
* Can travel up to 30% when needed

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT\&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data \+ AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30\+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers' success and to our Winning Culture.



Our customers rank among the who's who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.

* Growth mentality

description:

**Broadridge Trading \& Connectivity Solutions (BTCS)** is seeking a customer\-focused, technically capable professional to join our Customer Success team. As a **Customer Success Technical Account Manager**, you will serve as a strategic technical partner to clients using Broadridge trading platforms. You will help clients onboard successfully, adopt and optimise platform capabilities, overcome technical challenges, and realise sustained business value from their Broadridge solutions.

**Key** **Responsibilities**

* Build trusted, long\-term relationships with assigned clients and act as their primary technical advisor.
* Develop a strong understanding of each client’s business objectives, operating model, trading workflows, and technical environment.
* Drive adoption, optimisation, and value realisation across Broadridge solutions, identifying opportunities for broader usage and growth.
* Partner with Customer Success Managers and internal stakeholders to develop and execute account success plans aligned to client priorities.

* Minimum 3–4 years of relevant experience in the institutional brokerage ecosystem, including hands\-on support for trading applications.
* Good understanding of Indian financial markets, including NSE/BSE, the regulatory landscape, exchange trading, and the end\-to\-end trade lifecycle.
* Understanding of institutional order\-management workflows, including order entry, modification, cancellation, and execution.
* Familiarity with trading platforms, Order Management Systems (OMS), and/or Execution Management Systems (EMS).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both business and technical stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritise effectively in a fast\-paced, time\-sensitive trading environment.

**Preferred Skills \& Experience**

* Experience working with a stockbroker, institutional trading desk, trading technology provider, fintech, or capital\-markets firm.
* Exposure to Indian equities and derivatives markets.
* Familiarity with FIX connectivity and electronic trading workflows.
* Experience using AI and productivity tools to improve documentation, reporting, analysis, and routine operational tasks.


This role offers the opportunity to combine technical expertise, client relationship management, and capital\-markets knowledge to help clients achieve meaningful outcomes while building deep expertise in Broadridge’s trading and connectivity product suite.

description:

 **About Swiggy:**


Swiggy is India’s leading on\-demand delivery platform with a tech\-first approach to logistics and a solution\-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500\+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh\+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on\-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning\-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.

**Overview**
------------


A Key Account Manager owns high\-value restaurant partners within an assigned city, typically chains, established multi\-outlet restaurants, and growing independents expanding to multiple locations. These accounts are more complex: they involve negotiations with multiple stakeholders, larger deal sizes, custom solutions, and deeper engagement around ROI and strategy. You combine field presence with office\-based analysis and executive relationship management. Success requires both relationship skills and the analytical ability to build customized business cases. You mentor the Sales Manager tier and own a portion of the city\-wide targets.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own a portfolio of multi\-outlet restaurants: Manage 30\-40 high\-value accounts(60 to 80 in case of Indianext cities), each with 2\-10 outlets. These accounts represent 40\-60% of city revenue
* Executive relationship management: Build relationships with franchise owners, regional managers, and operational heads. You are often dealing with decision\-makers, not individual restaurant managers
* Consultative strategy: Move beyond product features. Help restaurants think about their growth strategy across, e.g., optimizing delivery times, increasing order frequency, and cross\-location consistency
* Field presence with data: Conduct monthly visits to key accounts to understand operations, gather feedback, troubleshoot adoption barriers, and surface new opportunities
* Advanced analytics: Build detailed business reviews (QBR) for accounts. Analyze their performance across cuisine, compare against benchmarks, and present growth strategies
* Pipeline development: Identify expansion opportunities with existing accounts (new locations, new products/cuisine). Turn your relationship into revenue growth
* Excel excellence: Build executive presentations, ROI models for pitches, and monthly and quarterly business reviews with charts and trend analysis. Your spreadsheets must be presentation\-ready for C\-level stakeholders
* 60 to 70 in\-person restaurant partner meetings in a month

--------------------------

 **Experience \& Background:**

* 2\-4 years in account management, B2B sales, or enterprise sales (proven progression from SDR/AE to AE or AM role)
* Track record in managing multi\-stakeholder deals
* Restaurant Business is a round\-the\-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
* Advanced Excel skills: pivot tables, VLOOKUP, data visualization, forecasting. You should be able to build a dashboard for each RP, which can help you and the restaurant partner to keep track of their business with us
* MBAs/PGDMs would be preferred in any discipline
* Strong Industry Understanding: Since this is a mid\-senior account management role, working knowledge of the restaurant ecosystem (unit economics, delivery margins, competitive landscape, aggregator dynamics) should be expected. Industry familiarity will significantly reduce ramp\-up time and improve consultative quality.

Job Description \- Curated Experience (Executive)
  
Role Summary
  
The Curated Experience Executive shall work closely in co\-ordination with the Curated Experience Sr. Executive ensuring visibility and presence on a day\-to\-day requirement \& ensure organization associates and visitors are welcomed, valued, and taken care of at every stage while they are in the office.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
Guest Experience
  
The Executive is the first face a colleague sees and the last impression a guest carries with them. This means expressing warmth and professionalism at reception or entry, greeting people with care, and creating an atmosphere where every individual feels that their presence matters. Beyond the greeting, the Executive takes ownership of the physical readiness of the workplace by conducting regular and thorough checks of meeting rooms, collaboration spaces, pantries, and common areas to ensure everything is clean, stocked, and ready for use before it is needed. Responding to ad\-hoc colleague requests is done promptly and with a helpful spirit, and feedback collected during daily interactions is documented accurately and shared with the Sr. Executive to drive meaningful resolutions.
  
  

Operational Support
  
The Executive plays an active role in keeping daily operations flowing smoothly. Service requests are logged, tracked, and followed through to full resolution, with timely status updates provided to colleagues along the way. Daily site inspections are conducted with a watchful eye, identifying maintenance issues, supply gaps, or safety concerns before they escalate. Routine matters are channeled to the Curated Experience Sr. Executive, while safety or security concerns are escalated directly and immediately to the Facility Manager / Security Team. Trackers, logs, and basic operational reports are maintained with accuracy and consistency.
  
  

Conference \& Event Support
  
Executive ensures every room is set up to the highest standard viz., equipment tested, AV confirmed, refreshments in place (where requested), and the space reset promptly after every meeting concludes. For workplace events, training sessions, and engagement activities, the Executive provides dedicated on\-ground support, working alongside the Sr. Executive to deliver a seamless experience for every attendee.
  
  

Colleague Engagement \& Onboarding
  
Executive shall play a central role in making new hires feel genuinely at home from day one. Leading the site orientation tours, introducing colleagues to amenities, explaining workplace policies, and setting a warm and welcoming tone are all core to this responsibility. All colleague enquiries, whether received in person, via email or through chat are acknowledged and responded to within one business day. Executive also takes an active approach to learning by shadowing the Curated Experience Sr. Executive across site functions, building both capability and confidence within the Workplace Services environment.
  
  

Feedback \& Continuous Improvement
  
Executive shall gather real\-time experience feedback from colleagues and stakeholders during daily interactions, tours, and events, and document it accurately using designated trackers. Executive serves as a trusted first point of contact for routine transport and commute queries, helping colleagues (especially new hires) navigate shuttle schedules, parking allocations, and booking protocols with confidence and ease.
